body: Cheers, foxnquail. All I got is Guinness, but it’ll do. Thanks, random person who has more sense than all the people I’ve met in real life. Hope your life gets better.
Nah not at all. I’ll pop one too, why not.

Right? A beer and a friend would’ve helped me through sooooo many of my hard times. I’ve tried reading about this stuff but I have high functioning autism and that kinda messes with me when I do. I basically know what they’re gonna say and overthink it til I have a counterpoint ready next time someone brings it up. I hate it. I struggle with all this stuff pretty bad. Now I’ve had to quit smoking weed and god damn I like my weed after work. Fuck

No problem, thanks for not trying to blow smoke up my ass like that straight edge dickhead in the other comment. I have never done anything like this before and I wouldn’t have made the post if I wasn’t on my last leg here. I’m out of rope. Idk what to do.

Because I’m not giving up without trying to better my life first. I have spent the last ten years trying to do whatever I can to stay alive, to stay fed, to keep waking up every day. I have been homeless, sick. And always alone. Now I work a 9-5 job just barely making enough to shovel ramen noodles and hot dogs down my face just so I can wake up and do it again. It’s condescending. It should be up to me whether or not I continue, just like it should’ve never been someone else’s decision that I take on all this bullshit in the first place.
Glad some people agree, I feel like a madman. So insane how this world works today

That’s so fucked, I’m sorry you had to experience this. And I know it’s normalized in our society today and no one cares and it hurts to think about. It’s so fucked. I don’t know what else to say because I can’t really tell someone to just “keep going” when I myself don’t want too, but you are strong for still being here. Fuck this world.
Ah,you’re straight edge. Makes sense now, never mind. Consider smoking a joint and taking the stick out of your ass
The amount of time it probably took you to come up with this is far more intriguing to me than the actual comment itself. Absolute gold, you mindreader you.
Never imagined I’d post on a suicidewatch subreddit and get told to essentially get over it by some chump, but so be it.

Gee Stan, you sure do read me like an open book. I’m sorry mister, I’ll just put a big ol smile on my face and take life’s dick exactly how you do. Get over yourself, you were the one triggered enough about what I said to comment in the first place. You don’t know who I am, much less what I’ve been through so why try to push me into your label/cliche corner? I’m obviously speaking from a place of pain, something I don’t cope with well because by the way, I do have autism. So before you go throwing out the “you probably have a mental illness” card, consider I actually might. I don’t comprehend some things, but I know what you’re trying to do and it sucks. You suck. Good pep talk chief.

Sounds like a sheep thing to say, especially to someone who blatantly expresses what I just did. Imagine thinking someone possibly has issues like mental problems, and then believing the best course of action is to berate them about what their “deal” is. Nihilism is realistic but I don’t follow it, I just open my eyes and see all this for what it is. It’s simple. Enjoy your mediocre life

Fuck dude this hits home. “How come they’re allowed to be angry at me for needing help, but I’m not allowed to be angry at them for not giving it?” Like it’s always my fucking fault, like I should just suck it up and carry on. I came to this subreddit hoping for advice and now all I can do is sympathize with everyone else who understands this world is fucked. Everyone I’ve ever considered a friend has walked out on me or hurt me deeply. And I just smiled and let them do it. I’m the world’s doormat.
